summary: Remote-shell agent: WebSocket/WebRTC connection to author-controlled relay drives local PTY-backed /bin/sh
details: sextant-cli-linux-amd64 ships a Linux/amd64 Go binary that operates as a remote-access agent. The binary imports github.com/pion/webrtc/v4, github.com/pion/datachannel, github.com/coder/websocket, github.com/creack/pty, and os/exec, and contains hardcoded references to wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. On execution it establishes a WebSocket/WebRTC signaling channel to the author-controlled relay at relay.sextant.top and attaches a PTY-backed /bin/sh or /bin/bash to that channel, giving the remote peer interactive shell access to the host. The binary additionally contains https://claude.ai/install.sh colocated with curl and /install handlers, positioning a fetch-and-execute of a shell installer under a URL that impersonates Anthropic-hosted content, and http://ip-api.com/json/ for public-IP/geolocation fingerprinting of the connecting host. package.json declares its license as "SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control" — the license repository slug (ddos798/claude_control) is inconsistent with the advertised sextant product name and consistent with offensive remote-control tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
